title.narrative: Output 2.1. Increased capacity of the member States to ratify international labour standards

description.narrative:
In July 2021, the Government of Mauritius, under the leadership of the Ministry of Labour, Human Resource Development and Training, ratified C.190 on violence and harassment in the world of work, 2019 and accepted its accompanying Violence and Harassment Recommendation, 2019 (No. 206) subsequent to the agreement of the Cabinet during its meeting in 18 December 2020.
The ratification instrument was deposited on 1st of July 2021 and is being implemented in the country through the a workshop training led by the Ministry of Foreign Affairs.
The ILO provided technical assistance to the Ministry of Labour, Human Resource Development and Training and the social partners on the way of carrying out the process, through: - advice and presentation of the Convention provided by the CO-Antananarivo during the mission of the Director in Mauritius. - technical advice provided by email and phone calls during the covid-19 pandemic. - Facilitation of the preparation of the signature between the ILO and Mauritius during the deposit of the instrument of ratification to ILO. As part of the implementation of C.190, the ILO is contributing to a workshop on International Conventions related to Gender Based Violence. The Gender Specialist based in Pretoria Office will give a presentation on C190 during the workshop on international Conventions linked to gender-based violence. Discussions were also carried out with the Ministry of Foreign Affairs, leading to the launch of this event scheduled on 1st of September 2021 and to hold several subsequent sessions of training of trainers so that the ILO Gender Specialist could partake more time on conveying the essence of the Convention but also on the various measures underlying a ratification of such a Convention. The Country is interested in a Protocol of Gender-Based Violence, awaiting the formal request from the Ministry of Civil Service. Training of Gender focal points is also of interest to the country. Discussions are currently being held with the social partners thereon.
